---
title: "Epics"
---

Every epic on the [OpenGWASDB project board](https://github.com/orgs/opengwas/projects/1),
in Workstream order, with its Status, its sub-issue progress and whether it has a
committed epic record yet. Each epic has a page of its own: its purpose, what the
board states, its tickets as a graph with their blocked-by edges, its decisions,
the versions it shipped, and — once its record exists — the catalog totals, the
yardstick measures and the test time before and after.

**This page is generated at render time** by
[`src/project_site/pages.py`](../src/project_site/pages.py) from the board
collector's output and the records under `docs/_epics/`; the render replaces this
file. Run `pixi run site-data` and then `pixi run site` to see it.
